popCulture.title: Lycurgus of Thrace
popCulture.description: The Edonian king who drove Dionysus' nurses with an ox-goad — Homer's first persecutor of the god, blinded and short-lived after.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: Iliad 6 — Diomedes recalls Lycurgus' hubris against Dionysus — the epic's warning that even heroes should not chase the god into the sea.

popCulture.title: The Bacchae
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Theban climax keeps the Lycurgus pattern alive — the king who insults Dionysus and is torn apart for it.
